query: BEGIN; SELECT set_config('test.student_a',(SELECT id::text FROM public.profiles WHERE role='student' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1),true); SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub',current_setting('test.student_a'),true); SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated; CREATE TEMP TABLE verification(owner_visible integer,weighted_average numeric,subject_coefficient numeric) ON COMMIT DROP; INSERT INTO public.edutech_grades(student_id,subject_offering_id,subject_label_legacy,school_year,term,assessment_type,grade,max_grade,assessment_coefficient,assessment_date,comment,include_in_average,created_by_student) SELECT auth.uid(),o.id,'Français','2026-2027','T1','devoir_classe',v.grade,20,v.assessment_coefficient,'2026-01-15','Test transactionnel Commande 10.1',true,true FROM (VALUES (15::numeric,2::numeric),(12::numeric,1::numeric),(14::numeric,2::numeric)) AS v(grade,assessment_coefficient) CROSS JOIN public.course_subject_offerings o JOIN public.levels l ON l.id=o.level_id JOIN public.series sr ON sr.id=o.series_id JOIN public.subjects s ON s.id=o.subject_id WHERE l.name='Terminale' AND sr.name='A1' AND s.name='Français'; INSERT INTO verification SELECT count(*),round(sum((grade/max_grade)*20*assessment_coefficient)/sum(assessment_coefficient),2),(SELECT c.coefficient FROM public.edutech_coefficients c JOIN public.course_subject_offerings o ON o.id=c.subject_offering_id JOIN public.levels l ON l.id=o.level_id JOIN public.series sr ON sr.id=o.series_id JOIN public.subjects s ON s.id=o.subject_id WHERE l.name='Terminale' AND sr.name='A1' AND s.name='Français' AND c.is_verified LIMIT 1) FROM public.edutech_grades WHERE comment='Test transactionnel Commande 10.1'; SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub','00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001',true); SELECT (SELECT owner_visible FROM verification LIMIT 1) AS owner_visible,(SELECT weighted_average FROM verification LIMIT 1) AS weighted_average_french,(SELECT subject_coefficient FROM verification LIMIT 1) AS french_subject_coefficient,count(*) AS visible_to_second_identity FROM public.edutech_grades WHERE comment='Test transactionnel Commande 10.1'; ROLLBACK;
